Hi Sophie / Acme team,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier this week — we’d like to set two focused sessions so we can move the procurement and technical approvals in parallel. Proposed approach:

1) Technical deep-dive (AE + SE + Customer Eng + Security engineer) — demo focused on expected throughput, latency, and dedicated sizing assumptions.
2) Procurement/pricing + contract timeline call (AE + Procurement + Finance/Legal) — review pricing tiers, committed capacity vs. hosted delta, and procurement timeline.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 20 Apr, 10:00–11:00 (technical)
- Fri 23 Apr, 09:00–10:00 (procurement/pricing)

If those don’t work please suggest 2 alternatives. I’ve attached the latest pricing deck and SOC2 summary for review; Karthik will bring the sizing calc to the technical call.

Agenda (technical): demo walkthrough, expected usage & RPS, dedicated sizing assumptions, security Q&A.
Agenda (procurement): pricing tiers, contract milestones, PO timelines, DocuSign next steps.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing + discount scenarios), SOC2-summary.pdf (security snapshot)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

- Security pre-read: Thu 22 Apr, 09:30–10:00 PT (Raj and security will join)

2) Confirm the total committed GPU estimate for the 12-month committed tier so procurement can compare to our budget.
